question_conditioning: Does specifying a moral aspect improve held-out similarity/retrieval relative to an unconditioned embedding?
question_geometry: Does enforcing inner-product geometry on otherwise unconstrained similarity predictions improve held-out fidelity or retrieval, rather than merely making the score matrix PSD?
scope: Overnight computational pilot; existing human evidence and synthetic probes reported separately. No new-human-validation claim.
primary_outcomes: scenario-family-held-out ranking accuracy on controlled probes
Spearman agreement with available published human pair judgments
expert-grounded retrieval relevance where existing labels permit
secondary_outcomes: PSD-fit distortion under a predeclared fixed score mapping and unit diagonal
sensitivity to relevant factual edits versus irrelevant wording edits
wall time, failed work, compute, and provenance overhead
comparison_arms: geometry-constrained variant only when it adds a restriction beyond the preceding arms
design_rules: Cosine bi-encoder Gram matrices are already PSD; transforming cosine to Euclidean distance is not an improvement arm.
Hold each moral condition fixed across each similarity matrix; never pool unrelated conditions to test PSD.

Fit transformations, hyperparameters, score calibrations, and projection completion only on training/development observations. Test labels cannot be used to complete, repair, project, select, or tune predictions.
Scenario families rather than arbitrary pairs define train/dev/test groups. Freeze data IDs, split, conditions, inference prompts and metrics before inspecting evaluation results.
Keep published human labels, LLM labels and author-designed synthetic expectations distinct in files and tables. Preserve original human scores and disagreements.
A projected score matrix over a fixed known collection is transductive evidence. Generalization to unseen situations requires an actual text-to-score/embedding function and held-out families.
PSD and unit diagonal ensure a consistent inner-product representation, not moral correctness. Do not score known architectural guarantees as task performance.
If a needed checkpoint or arm is unavailable, record the missing comparison and continue useful independent arms. Never silently replace the evaluated question.
An architecture comparison alone cannot isolate a PSD causal effect; report capacity/training differences. If no clean intervention fits the budget, mark geometry benefit unresolved.
Synthetic probes are a falsification screen, not a new human-validated moral benchmark.
sufficient_checks: one end-to-end tiny run through load->score->evaluate->save
no split-family overlap and no test-label use during fitting
independent recomputation of final metrics from saved predictions
one simulated interrupted-stage resume/no-duplicate check before unattended execution

viper.policy: local-first provenance plus separate durable asynchronous publisher

report_rule: At deadline publish observed results, missing arms, failures, costs, uncertainties, and pursue/revise/abandon recommendation. Optional instrumentation or formatting cannot delay the scientific report.
cleanup_rule: Delete only task-created billable resources after retained artifacts are verified; include boot/data disks, reservations and IPs. Preserve the pre-existing dev VM and unrelated resources.
allowed_actions: Implement, execute, repair within these bounds, commit/push task paths, publish results, and clean up task resources without another confirmation. No IAM/authentication changes or broad infrastructure work.
